notes.title: Patch 0.13 Live "Juiced Up"
notes.content:
Bugs:
[list]
[*] Attack up, and Block up now abide by master volume.
[*] Rare occasion where store turn rarity was being saved to new builds has been addressed
[*] Matchmaking now has been addressed as older builds were only what were being fought.
[/list]

Features:
[list]
[*] Speed up of tally animations
[*] Jackpots now have character animations
[*] Floating numbers above player for when healed / direct damaged.
[*] if an symbol gains more than 2 multi in a combat spin it is on fire.
[*] little card description love.
[*] Spelling errors fixed
[*] Fully blocking now shows "Blocked" (expect some skills to be created for when achieving this)
[*] Tut is broken up to several parts
[/list]

Balancing:
[list]
[*] Only 1 bonus roll allowed per combat spin, perhaps a skill will be made to allow more.
[*] Categories are going to be hard locked to 15.  Thus forcing more variation and reducing jackpot spam.
[/list]

Hunter:
[list]
[*] Bronze quiver, gain 3 block exhaust to gain 15 attack
[*] Iron Arrow, gain 5 atk, exhaust deal 5 direct damage
[/list]

Books:
[list]
[*] Bookworm now altered to be temp upgrade of +4
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.12 Live
notes.content:
[h1]**Patch 0.12 Live**[/h1]

[b]
Skill:[/b]
[list]
[*] Blood lust correctly does not trigger after bonus spin cap
[/list]
[b]
Game:[/b]
[list]
[*] burst reward (treasure snail example) does not reward double amounts was happening on all burst of damage.
[*] Rogue class added to beta (demo payers may fight against).
[/list]
[b]
Server:[/b]
[list]
[*] Correctly filtering out older builds
[*] Gold gain can not be cheesed, reroll now  saves correctly between revisiting
[/list]


Any feedback is appreciated let me know if some builds still feel to OP, or things need tweaked I am currently looking at Death Eaters as I feel like swamp builds are still to OP.    I believe symbols need to be increased to 23 or 25 so there will always be some symbols which are not on the machine while spinned, but getting a 4 row jackpot is still possible.

notes.title: Patch - v0.11 LIVE
notes.content:
[h1]**Patch - v0.11 LIVE** [/h1]

[b]Non Class Symbol changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Water Flask changed to 30% chance to create Dew Drop Gem
[*] Dew drop gem changed to 3% heal hp 
[*] Pumkin Helm changed to 8% heal hp
[*] Gem of Elements changed to 3 multiplier
[*] Rune of wine changed to 3 multiplier
[/list]

[b]Necro changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bone dragon changed to 1 temp multiplier 
[*] Death eaters now 100% exhaust
[*] Dark Pact now changes exhaust from 100% to 80%
[*] Book of shadows now grants 1 temp multiplier correctly to all Dark mace adjacent.
[*] Death Cap changed to be only 1 adjacent hard bone will create Death Eater
[/list]


[b]Hunter changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Pack dog altered to 2 temp multiplier
[*] Diamond Arrow changed to 40 direct damage.
[*] Fur cape description to check only 1 adjacent.
[/list]

[b]Game Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Stalemate counter added.  After it counts down from 15 spins if no one is winning it becomes a draw.
[*] Bonus spins now capped at 2 per a combat spin.
[*] Tutorial now progresses through clicking of shop keep. 
[*] Required to win is now set to 8 instead of 10
[*] Opponent selection and matchmaking will now happen on turn instead of win loss turn.
[*] Removed perminent in item descriptions as it was missleading
[*] Gold carries over,
[*] Reroll now increases by 1 gold after each use in the shop (starts at 1).
[*] Catagory rarity now starts to kick in once you have 17 of a specific catagory, it was set at 15 before.
[*] Remove button and roll button now lock if not enough gold.
[/list]
[b]
Error handling:[/b]
[list]
[*] Notified if missmatched version
[*] Notified if server is offline
[*] notified if auth has failed
[/list]
[b]
Skins, and rewards:[/b]
[list]
[*] Trophies are now rewarded through play and will be usable for rewards.
[*] Trophies will be reset to 0 upon release, Unlocks will not...(except if i screw something up).
[*] Trophies are only earned through round wins, if a run is a win you get 2 additional for a grand total of 10 per run.
[*] Trophies are seasonal and will be reset to 0 upon season change
[*] Seasonal weapon skins and hero skins added in rewards tab
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.11 Announcement
notes.content:
[h1]Upcoming **Patch - v0.11**[/h1]

[b]Non Class Symbol changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Dew drop gem changed to 3% heal hp 
[*] Pumpkin Helm changed to 8% heal hp 
[/list]

[b]Necro changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bone dragon changed to 1 temp multiplier 
[*] Death eaters now 100% exhaust
[*] Dark Pact now changes exhaust from 100% to 80%
[/list]

[b]Hunter changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Pack dog altered to 2 temp multiplier
[*] Diamond Arrow changed to 40 direct damage.
[/list]

[b]Game Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Stalemate counter added.  After it counts down from 15 spins if no one is winning it becomes a draw 
[*] Tutorial now progresses through clicking of shop keep (will be reset for everyone). 
[*] Required to win is now set to 8 instead of 10
[*] Opponent selection and matchmaking will now happen on turn instead of win loss turn.
[*] Removed permanent in item descriptions as it was misleading
[*] Gold carries over,
[*] Reroll now doubles over rolling in shop, will not persist through store visits (cost starts at 1).
[*] Empty slots now go up to 23... So you will need to figure in symbols which will not appear.
[*] Category rarity now starts to kick in once you have 17 of a specific catagory, it was set at 15 before.
[/list]


[b]Skins, and rewards:[/b]
[list]
[*] Trophies are now rewarded through play and will be usable for rewards.
[*] Trophies will be reset to 0 upon release, Unlocks will not...(except if i screw something up).
[*] Trophies are only earned through round wins, there is no bonus if you win a run so play what you want! (absolutely no micro transactions).
[*] Trophies are seasonal and will be reset to 0 upon season change
[*] Seasonal weapon skins and hero skins added in rewards tab
[/list]


Patch will be live sometime this week
